task.goal: In Simple Calendar Pro, create a calendar event for tomorrow at 10h with the title 'Call with Alice' and the description 'We will celebrate contract details. Looking forward to productive discussions.'. The event should last for 45 mins.
task.final_summary: Created "Call with Alice" in Simple Calendar Pro for tomorrow, Monday October 16, from 10:00 to 10:45 (45 minutes), with the description "We will celebrate contract details. Looking forward to productive discussions." The day view for October 16 shows the single event with that title, the 10:00 - 10:45 time, and the full description.

steps.note: Read simple-calendar skill, then observe screen
Read simple-calendar skill, then observe screen
Launch Simple Calendar Pro and start a new event
Tap New Event FAB and inspect the event form
Tap Event option and read the event form
Type title into event_title field
Type description into event_description field
Open start date picker and pick October 16
Check whether date picker dialog is showing
Select 16 in date picker then tap OK
Tap OK to set start date Oct 16; then set start time 10:00
Open start time picker and set 10:00
Switch time picker to text input mode
Type hour 10 then minute 00 and OK
Re-read time picker text input fields
Tap OK for start time 10:00, then set end time 10:45
Open end time picker and set 10:45
Switch end time picker to text mode
Tap minute field then type 45
Tap minute field area to focus it
Type 45 into minute field
Read minute field state after typing
Fix hour field back to 10
Read picker state
Type 45 into focused minute field
Clear minute field, then use clock face to pick 45
Switch to clock mode and pick minute 45
Tap 45 on the minute clock face
Confirm end time 10:45 and read the form
Tap Save and verify the saved event
Dismiss disclaimer and verify event saved
Search for the event to verify it saved
Tap Oct 16 in month grid to see its day view
Task complete
